title: Import from an OpenAPI spec
description: Paste an OpenAPI or Swagger document: its endpoints become one toolbox, an action per endpoint, with arguments taken from each path and query.
setup_notes: For an authenticated API, add its credential first (Admin > Credentials) and give its name below. The toolbox installs pending: approve it in Admin > Tools. A large API is easier to work with narrowed by a path prefix.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Toolbox name
questions.help: Letters, digits and underscores, e.g. petstore.

questions.name: base_url
questions.label: Base address (optional)
questions.help: Taken from the document's server; set it only if that is wrong.

questions.name: credential
questions.label: Credential
questions.help: The name of an API credential, or no_auth for a public API.

questions.name: filter
questions.label: Path prefix (optional)
questions.help: Only import endpoints under this path, e.g. /pets.
